name: CloudStream Desktop Extensions
description: Installable WebAssembly extensions for CloudStream Desktop. The Android .cs3 plugins from Niloy's repository cannot be installed here: they are Kotlin APKs and this runtime executes wasm32 modules. Every entry below is a native module built for this runtime; binary URLs are absolute so this index works from any build.

extensions.name: CTGMovies
extensions.description: Films, series and anime from ctgmovies.com, with direct file links for playback.
